Haunter

Ghost Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Haunter is a Ghost/Poison-type Gas Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 0.1 kg. It evolves from Gastly and into Gengar. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (115), with a base stat total of 405.
